issue: तब कर जोरी विनय उस कीन्ह्यो (and chaupāī 6, उस अयोग्य वर मांगन हारी): उस ('that') does not fit the grammar; अस ('thus', 'such') would. Every copy found online is Drik Panchang's text.
our reading: उस, as Drik Panchang prints it: 'made a prayer to him' (cau3), 'you who ask for that unfitting boon' (cau6).

issue: दीन्हो श्राप कध पर आनी: कध is not a word, and the half is a mātrā short.
our reading: कध cannot be read as printed; the meaning takes क्रोध: Lakṣmī, hearing Tulasī's words, grew angry and cursed her.
alternatives: कंध ('shoulder'): 'brought the curse upon her shoulders'.

issue: समय पाई व्हौ रौ पाती तोरा: व्हौ रौ पाती is not readable as printed.
our reading: as printed: 'in time I shall be your husband'.

issue: सुनी उर शोक उपारा: the second half has 13 mātrās for 16; a word is missing (Vṛndā, who hears of her husband's death), and उपारा would be अपारा ('boundless').
alternatives: सुनि वृन्दा उर शोक अपारा, or similar.

issue: दियो श्राप बिना विचारे: the half has 14 mātrās for 16; a word is missing.
alternatives: a word such as तुम or अस before बिना.

issue: धग्व रूप हम शालिग्रामा: धग्व is not a word.
our reading: as printed: 'I (Hari) shall be the śālagrāma stone'.
alternatives: दग्ध, or another word for the stone form.

issue: तुलसी महिमा नाम लख तुलसी सूत सुखराम । मानस चालीस रच्यो जग महं तुलसीदास: the dohā does not rhyme (सुखराम / तुलसीदास), and सूत, मानस चालीस are unclear; it seems to name the poet or a Tulasīdāsa.
alternatives: none found: every copy online is Drik Panchang's text.

issue: कवि सुन्दर इक हरि गुण गावत: the signature; इक read with कवि सुन्दर ('a poet, Sundara'). The same poet signs the Gaṅgā and Śītalā Chālīsās (Sundaradāsa, Rāmasundara Prabhudāsa).
our reading: Sundara, a poet, sings Hari's praises; singing near Tulasī, he gains a thousandfold fruit.
alternatives: इक as 'alone, only' (sings only Hari's praises); or 'one who sings Hari's praises near Tulasī gains a thousandfold' (a general statement, the poet only named).

issue: सकल दुःख दरिद्र हरि हार ह्वै परम प्रसन्न । आशिय धन जन लड़हि ग्रह बसही पूर्णा अत्र: हार is unexplained, लड़हि is read as लहहि ('obtain'), and अत्र ('here') likely stands for अन्न ('grain', rhyming with प्रसन्न).
our reading: Supremely pleased, Hari takes away all sorrow and poverty; blessings, wealth and family are gained, and the home here dwells full.
alternatives: …and the home dwells full of grain (अन्न).
